name: California Bar Ethics Overlay
description:
Regime overlay for California's stricter attorney-client standard (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 6068(e)(1), CA COPRAC Practical Guidance for Generative AI 2026). Carries no membership of its own — it contributes overrides on top of whatever the selected theme policies resolve.

What it enforces, and how it differs from the ABA baseline: California requires full anonymization rather than tokenization, because a token sent to an external AI system still transmits identifying information. So a case caption is flagged for attorney review instead of being tokenized; a composite privilege detection becomes a hard block under the 2026 agentic-AI guidance prohibiting autonomous external transmission; and personal attributes are treated as quasi-identifiers that re-identify a client in combination — high across the board, critical for direct contact details.

Requires: the aba-ethics overlay. This policy declares the cal-bar-ethics profile, whose requires_profiles names aba-ethics, so the engine rejects a configuration that selects CA's stricter rules without the ABA baseline underneath (D17 T0 §3, D-3 — this replaces the old policy-extends chain).

Pair with: the legal and pii themes, and a configuration whose region lens includes US-CA.

Scope: California attorney-client confidentiality — overrides only
